metadata.recipient_description: a retail client comparing a fixed annuity with bank CDs

communication:
Hi Ruth,

Following up on our call: the Harbor Example Fixed Annuity pays 5.4% a year, locked in for seven years, and your principal is protected by the issuing insurer. It is a simple way to earn more than your bank CD.

Best,
Owen Pratt
Registered Representative, Lakemont Example Securities LLC, Member FINRA/SIPC

violations.excerpt: It is a simple way to earn more than your bank CD.

label.rationale: Correspondence. The pitch omits the annuity's trade-offs, so it is not fair and balanced under (d)(1)(A).
